placements.title: System behavior guarantees for ingestion pipeline correctness
placements.theme: The ingestion pipeline is engineered so that structural gaps in submitted content (like a missing id) are always resolved by a defined fallback path rather than causing failure.

placements.title: No memory is lost to a missing id — the pipeline always derives and commits a slug
placements.theme: When a memory arrives without an explicit id, the pipeline must still produce a usable slug — via LLM id-generation or, failing that, deterministic slugify — and commit the file, so ingestion never stalls on a missing identifier.
